shared_elements: head or headdress with linear/geometric markings
justification: Both surfaces include a schematized anthropomorphic figure with head/headdress markings and circular or geometric incised motifs, with the closest correspondence being the combination of a human-like body and associated disc/linear signs. The major difference is that A is a single large frontal, highly abstract body with circles and bands on the torso, while B is a profile standing figure in a more narrative relief field with surrounding glyph-like objects, plants/standards, and other signs.
